title: 단톡방 메시지 읽기: 생파, 칼퇴가 무슨 뜻이에요?
objective: You can read short forms like 생파, 칼퇴 and 불금 in a chat, guess new ones from their full words, and choose the full form in polite writing.
summary: Learn common Korean short forms and use them to read casual group chats.
note: Short forms change quickly. The words here are common in everyday chats today.

task.title: Read and use short forms
task.line: Use the word list and the tips on page 1 to read, choose or write the right form.

items.text: Short for 단체 카톡방, a group chat room on a messenger app.
Short for 아르바이트, a part-time job, often held by students.
Short for 혼자 밥 먹기. Use it as 혼밥하다.
Leaving work right at closing time, sharp as a knife (칼 + 퇴근).
From 불타는 금요일, 'burning Friday', a fun night before the weekend.
From 소소하지만 확실한 행복, a small everyday joy.
From 워크 라이프 밸런스, the balance between work and personal life.

sections.heading: 줄임말은 어떻게 만들어요?
paragraphs: Most Korean short forms take the first syllable of each word: 생일 파티 → 생파, 비밀번호 → 비번. When you see a new two- or three-syllable word in a chat, try to guess the long words behind it.

sections.heading: 언제 써요?
paragraphs: Short forms are fine in chats and when you talk with friends or coworkers your own age. In emails, reports, and with older people or customers, use the full form: 비밀번호를 알려 주시겠어요?

exercises: Read the message and answer in English: 유나: 이번 불금에 제 생파 해요! 장소는 단톡방에 올릴게요. ① 파티는 무슨 요일에 해요? ② 장소는 어디에서 확인해요?
Make the short form by taking the first syllable of each word: ① 남자 친구 ② 학생 식당 ③ 무료 배송
Choose the right word for each blank (알바, 워라밸, 소확행): ① 야근이 너무 많아서 ____이 없어요. ② 방학 동안 편의점 ____를 할 거예요. ③ 따뜻한 이불 속에서 책 읽기가 제 ____이에요.
Short form or full form? Write S (short form is fine) or F (use the full form): ① 교수님께 보내는 이메일 ② 친한 친구들과의 단톡방 ③ 회사 보고서 ④ 처음 만난 어른께 보내는 메시지
Rewrite the sentence using two short forms from the list: 오늘은 정시에 퇴근하고 혼자 밥을 먹을 거예요.
answers: ① On Friday night this week (불금 = 금요일 밤, a Friday night out) ② In the group chat (단톡방)
① 남친 ② 학식 ③ 무배
① 워라밸 ② 알바 ③ 소확행
① F ② S ③ F ④ F
오늘은 칼퇴하고 혼밥할 거예요. (Also possible: 오늘은 칼퇴하고 혼밥을 할 거예요.)
